name: R2-BRIDGE-01 Phase 0.1 -- DEV Selection Rule
purpose: Fills the protocol gap identified by the Phase-1 pre-execution gate: the original Phase-0 contract (decision_rules.json.decision_gate) defines the BRIDGE-HOLDOUT-stage outcome labels only. It never defined a rule for selecting ONE of the 12 frozen retention configurations from DEV evidence. This addendum freezes that missing rule, additively, before any DEV retention cell is executed or inspected.

selection_budget.rule: Selection happens ONLY at the primary 4 GiB budget. The 1.5 GiB and 8 GiB secondary budgets are robustness/descriptive analyses and MUST NOT influence which configuration is selected.
selection_budget.secondary_budget_non_influence: Any 1.5 GiB or 8 GiB result, however it compares to B_selected at those budgets, carries zero weight in the selection decision. The selection decision is a pure function of the 4 GiB cells alone.

dev_corpus.source: experiments/R2-09-prediction-benchmark/r2_09a/dev_corpus_manifest.json.selected_instances (the same 8 DEV cells R2-09A/R2-10 already froze)
dev_corpus.aggregation: equal weight per DEV instance -- arithmetic mean of the 8 per-instance miss_bytes_per_decode_step values. No token-count or step-count weighting across instances (identical discipline to R2-09A baseline-selection and R2-10 predictor-selection aggregation).

primary_selection_metric.definition: mean over the 8 DEV instances (equal weight) of bytes_missed/steps at the 4 GiB budget, computed via the exact existing replay semantics (argine.research2.r2_09a.fast_replay.run_fast, the same primary_physical_replay_quantity already frozen in experiments/R2-09-prediction-benchmark/metrics_contract.json).

mandatory_control.role: Mandatory implementation/control-equivalence cell only. Must reproduce B_selected(4 GiB)'s retention semantics exactly (bit-for-bit, per leakage_contract.json.control_equivalence). If control equivalence fails, Phase 1 DEV execution is blocked -- this is an implementation/protocol discrepancy, not a scientific result, and must be investigated before any selection proceeds.

candidate_validity_requirements: replay completes without exception (no InvariantViolation, no RuntimeError)
deterministic replay check passes (repeated replay of the same cell is bit-identical)
configuration identity matches retention_policy_space.json exactly (family_id, config_id, params)

rule: 1. lower equal-weight DEV mean misses_per_decode_step wins
2. if still tied, lexically ascending config_id wins
tie_break.no_additional_criteria_after_results: This two-step tie-break is exhaustive and frozen now. No additional tie-break criterion may be introduced after DEV results exist.

dev_progression_gate.rule: Let best = the eligible candidate (of the 3) with the lowest mean_dev_miss_bytes_per_decode_step_at_4gib (ties broken per tie_break above). Compare best.value against B_selected(4 GiB)'s own mean_dev_miss_bytes_per_decode_step_at_4gib.

outcomes.label: DEV_RETENTION_SIGNAL_POSITIVE
outcomes.action: Freeze exactly that one retention family/configuration for the fresh BRIDGE holdout. The holdout may then be captured/sealed under the existing Phase-0 acquisition contract (corpus_acquisition_contract.json) -- but still may not be OPENED until this freeze record exists.

outcomes.label: DEV_NO_RETENTION_IMPROVEMENT
outcomes.action: Do not open the fresh BRIDGE holdout. Do not propose R2-11. This is explicitly NOT the same as the frozen decision_rules.json BRIDGE_NEGATIVE label -- that label is reserved exclusively for a decision made from BRIDGE-HOLDOUT evidence, never from DEV evidence. A DEV_NO_RETENTION_IMPROVEMENT outcome produces a closure record, not a BRIDGE_NEGATIVE classification.

dev_progression_gate.distinctness_from_holdout_decision_gate: This DEV-stage gate and decision_rules.json's BRIDGE-holdout-stage decision_gate are two separate, non-interchangeable mechanisms. DEV_RETENTION_SIGNAL_POSITIVE/DEV_NO_RETENTION_IMPROVEMENT are DEV-only labels that gate whether the holdout may be opened at all; BRIDGE_NEGATIVE/BRIDGE_POSITIVE_BUT_WEAK/BRIDGE_POSITIVE remain exclusively holdout-stage labels, applied later, only if DEV_RETENTION_SIGNAL_POSITIVE is reached and the holdout is subsequently opened and evaluated.

may_report: selected mechanism behavior at 1.5 GiB and 8 GiB
all frozen configurations at those budgets, if already required by the Phase-0 grid
corresponding B_selected(M) comparisons at those budgets
secondary_budget_reporting.explicit_prohibition: Secondary-budget results, however favorable or unfavorable, MUST NOT change the 4 GiB selection decision made above. The selection decision is finalized from 4 GiB evidence alone before any secondary-budget result is even computed, let alone inspected for selection purposes.

no_dev_result_before_this_freeze: This addendum is authored and frozen with zero DEV retention cells computed. No file under experiments/R2-BRIDGE-01-retention-feasibility/ or any other path contains a DEV miss_bytes/retention result as of this addendum's commit.
